title: Regenerating ammo rack subsystem (static attributes)
description: Static attributes of a regenerating ammo rack: stock limit and self-regeneration. It holds stock only and runs no loading timer; the mechanical loading stage lives in the autoloader model (ammo_loader_static_attr.schema.json). The delivery spec (belt_definition) and service channels are per-instance fields, see dynamic/regen_ammo_rack_dynamic_attr.schema.json.

$schema.description: Path of this JSON Schema, used for editor completion and validation.

basic_durability.description: Durability limit. Reaching zero destroys the rack and detonates its actual stock; it recovers at 30% of the limit.

pass_damage.description: Whether damage is passed on to the subsystem host. First-party definitions write false: the rack absorbs hits itself.

limit_damage.description: Whether passed damage is limited to the remaining subsystem durability.

hidden.description: Whether the subsystem is hidden from the HUD.

capacity.description: Stock limit in rounds. Must be at least 1, otherwise a full delivery can never be assembled.

regen_per_minute.description: Produced rounds per minute. regen_round_by_round=true: per-round recovery rate; false: full-batch rate, batch duration = capacity / rate. 0 = no self-regeneration.

regen_round_by_round.description: Recovery granularity. true = regenerate while firing; false = refill the whole rack once empty.

energy_cost_per_round.description: Energy (J) consumed per produced round. 0 = free. A full batch is charged once at batch start.

regen_delay.description: Seconds to wait after a delivery before regeneration resumes.

sounds.description: Basic sounds. Progress sounds belong to the mechanical stage and are declared on the autoloader model.
